title: India may get plastic notes: Why they are being introduced & what happens to paper money
content: The RBI has recently floated a tender to procure material for polymer banknotes, reviving a proposal that has been under consideration for nearly two decades. Polymer notes, which are produced using durable plastic film instead of paper, generally have a longer lifespan and require replacement less frequently because they are more resistant to wear and tear.

title: Inside US-Saudi nuclear deal: Why Pakistan is biggest loser
content: The newly forged nuclear pact between the US and Saudi Arabia promises to transform the atomic dynamics in the region. This agreement grants Saudi Arabia the ability to enrich uranium domestically, supervised by the United States, effectively diminishing Pakistan's nuclear dominance. The emergence of a nuclear triangle comprising Israel, Iran, and Saudi Arabia signals a significant shift in U.S. non-proliferation efforts, embracing a tiered regional order.

title: Gurgaon road rage: Man beaten to death with iron rod, awl; cab driver held
content: An auto-rickshaw driver was beaten to death by a cabbie in Gurgaon. The fatal assault occurred after a dispute over who should give way. Passersby reportedly watched the incident unfold without intervening. The victim died from severe head injuries sustained during the attack. Police arrested the cab driver and are investigating the matter.

title: How Rajeev Kumar and his village gave 50 masseurs to Indian cricket
content: From walking Delhi's streets without a phone to becoming one of Indian cricket's most trusted support staff members, Rajeev Kumar's journey is one of resilience, humility and perseverance. The former India men's team masseur recalls his struggles, the people who shaped his career, and the unforgettable moments behind two generations in Indian cricket.

title: Sheikh Hasina plans Bangladesh return: 'I may be killed, I may be sent to prison'
content: Ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return to Bangladesh by December. She is prepared to face arrest, imprisonment, or even execution upon her arrival. Hasina fled the country in August 2024 after widespread protests ended her rule. Her party faces repression and legal proceedings following the change in government.

title: Apple hits $5 trillion; reason is Wall Street is unhappy with Google, Microsoft & others
content: Apple's market value briefly exceeded five trillion dollars on Tuesday.  This milestone was achieved after the company regained its position as the world's most valuable public company.  Unlike rivals, Apple rents AI infrastructure, preserving its strong cash flow.  This strategy contrasts with competitors facing increased debt and negative free cash flow.  Apple's stock has seen significant gains this year, outperforming Nvidia.

title: BSNL to pay Rs 30,000 after wrongly charging man Rs 65,000 for flight data
content: A consumer commission directed BSNL to revise a customer's mobile bill. The company wrongly charged for international roaming data while the customer was flying. Flight records confirmed the customer was airborne during the disputed data usage period. BSNL also failed to adjust a security deposit as required by policy. The commission awarded compensation for mental agony and litigation costs.

title: 'Kidnapped, questioned, abandoned': Man who disturbed food at Jantar Mantar moves SC
content: Junaid Malik approached the Supreme Court alleging police kidnapping and questioning.  He claims police sought details about food supply funds for the protest.  Delhi and UP police allegedly harassed his family members for his support.  Advocate Prashant Bhushan presented the allegations to the Chief Justice of India.  The court's scrutiny is sought to prevent state machinery intimidation.

title: How Europe's heatwave is proving Americans right about air conditioning
content: Europeans are now buying air conditioning units in unprecedented numbers. Manufacturers report significant sales growth across several European countries. This shift is driven by both comfort and public health concerns. Rising temperatures and extreme heat events are becoming impossible to ignore. Cultural attitudes towards cooling solutions are beginning to change.

title: 'He's on drugs 24 hours': BJP MLA booked over remarks against Rahul Gandhi
content: Udupi police registered an FIR against BJP MLA Yashpal Suvarna for alleged hate speech.  The case was filed following a complaint lodged by the Udupi District Congress president.  Suvarna allegedly made derogatory remarks against Rahul Gandhi during a protest event.  The Karnataka government is examining the matter and will initiate legal action.  Further legal proceedings will be initiated in connection with the case.

title: China restores 22,500 hectares of mangroves after losing over half
content: China has made remarkable strides in restoring its mangrove ecosystems, committing to large-scale projects that have expanded coverage significantly. By planting and revitalizing thousands of hectares, not only has biodiversity surged, but the quality of these crucial habitats has also seen improvement. Robust legal measures now safeguard more than ninety percent of mangrove areas, complemented by the establishment of an international center focused on mangrove conservation in Shenzhen.

title: US bans Chinese humanoid robots that Elon Musk once called Tesla's biggest rival
content: The US Federal Communications Commission has banned Chinese humanoid robots citing national security concerns. Advanced robotic devices pose unacceptable risks to United States security and its citizens. These robots possess sensors capable of collecting sensitive data on their surroundings. China is identified as a significant competitor in the growing humanoid robot market. This move tightens US control on Chinese technology across various sectors.

title: 'My mother was a little upset': CWG medallist Harjinder reveals emotional call
content: Indian weightlifter Harjinder Kaur revealed she first called her mother after winning silver in the women's 69kg event at the Commonwealth Games 2026, adding that she was "a little upset" because Harjinder had been away competing for so long. The 29-year-old also said she was pleased with her consistency and proud to upgrade her Birmingham 2022 bronze to silver.

title: Delhi Police serves notice to X over 'derogatory' posts targeting constitutional heads

This action follows similar directives for posts targeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi.  The police social media monitoring team continuously scans for objectionable online material.  These developments occur amid heightened political tensions following recent student protests.

title: Gold price prediction today: What factors will determine gold's movement?
content: Gold price prediction today: Both gold and silver prices are expected to be volatile this week ahead of the US Federal Reserve’s policy, says Vedika Narvekar, Research Analyst - Commodities & Currencies, Anand Rathi Shares and Stock Brokers.

title: 'No shorts' sparks protest at DU's St Stephen's College on first day of new session
content: St Stephen's College has banned shorts in several campus areas. This new regulation has led to student protests and a demonstration on campus. Students claim the restriction applies to all members, not just juniors. The college's new principal issued the dress code notification. Teachers have assured students the rule will not be strictly enforced.

title: Gone in 16 days: Dehradun’s Rs 16 crore bridge collapses in rain
content: A newly inaugurated bridge's approach road collapsed due to heavy rainfall. The incident occurred just seventeen days after the bridge opened to traffic. Officials stated the bridge itself remains structurally safe while the approach road washed away. An investigation has been ordered to determine responsibility for the construction lapses. Traffic has been diverted as authorities work to restore the damaged road.

title: Middle East war: Multiple dead in US-Saudi strikes in Iraq; Iran hits Hormuz ships

title: 'Girls enjoy being raped': Right-wing commentator booked over remarks on CJP stir

The complaint alleged his videos aimed to disturb public peace and create fear.  The case invokes sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and IT Act.  Further investigation into the uploaded and circulated videos is currently underway.

title: 'Gutter mouth, witch': Rakhi Sawant slams Kangana Ranaut over Gen Z protest remarks

Ranaut had previously spoken against the use of obscene language during protests.  She also mentioned that Prime Minister Modi and his late mother were targeted.  The exchange highlights differing views on recent student agitations.

Dadlani defended the students, saying they were lathi-charged, tear-gassed, and beaten, adding "you earned the gaalis." He also criticised "paid story-campaigns" against the protesters, sparking widespread backlash against Kangana online.

title: WTC 2025-27 points table: Pakistan slump to last; where do India stand?
content: Pakistan slumped to the bottom of the ICC World Test Championship 2025-27 standings after a 90-run defeat to the West Indies, their eighth consecutive away Test loss. Jayden Seales and Justin Greaves starred in the win, while Babar Azam's unbeaten 58 went in vain. India are fifth in the standings, with Australia leading and South Africa second.

title: NEET probe: CBI given 3 days to file chargesheet annexures, hearing on Aug 3

title: Kerala HC grants bail in NDPS case over lapse in informing accused's family

The police had failed to inform a relative or friend of the arrested individual.  Merely informing the live-in partner's father did not satisfy the law.  The court emphasized procedural safeguards for arrested persons under BNSS.

title: Rupee gains for fourth straight session as dollar weakens, oil prices remain below $90
content: The Indian Rupee strengthened for a fourth straight session on Wednesday. It gained five paise against the US dollar, reaching 95.77. This rise was supported by a softer American currency and lower crude oil prices. Improved domestic equity sentiment and foreign investor buying also boosted the rupee. Market participants watched the dollar index and crude oil price movements closely.

title: 'I had 2 National Awards at his age': Kangana hits back at CJP's Saurav Das

Kangana's reaction came after Saurav Das criticised her comments against Gen Z protesters, including her description of the younger generation as "Generation Gutter".

title: 'Marriage proposals pour in' for Abhijeet Dipke, CJP founder has one condition

title: CWG 2026 medal tally: Where does India stand after Day 6 in Glasgow?

Three Indian boxers secured semifinal spots, guaranteeing medals. India ended the day ninth in the standings with 12 medals, while Australia remained on top.

Repeated excuses to avoid marital relations raised suspicions within the groom's family. Police have filed a case against five family members while awaiting verification of the claim. The groom's family alleged they spent significant money on the wedding ceremony.

title: India's cities need $2.4 trillion by 2050, but where will the money come from
content: Indian cities need $2.4 trillion by 2050 for climate resilience and low-carbon development. Municipal corporations face significant revenue and capital access limitations currently. Urban infrastructure investments of $840 billion are projected over the next fifteen years. Cities must become investment-ready entities to attract necessary capital for growth. This financial strengthening is crucial for achieving the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision.

The incident highlights a woman's courage in reporting harassment.
